and REST APIs; continuously upskilling across GenAI and Data Science.

– Designed RESTful Flask APIs connecting ML backends to a ReactJS frontend for real-time AI decision support, reducing farmers' crop-loss risk

– Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot enabling natural-language question-answering over PDF and DOCX documents,

– Implemented a dual embedding pipeline (local Sentence-Transformers and Gemini cloud embeddings) with FAISS vector search for fast, 
accurate semantic retrieval. 
– Engineered strict context-grounded prompting to minimize hallucinations and deliver real-time, token-streamed answers through an 
interactive Streamlit chat interface.

management.
